absolute paths ride the same read), then the repo layout (src/, lib/),
then /mentl-home/{src,lib} — the well-known guest path the install shim
maps the repo to. An address, not an env var; in-repo behavior is
byte-identical and the E_MissingModule diagnostic keeps its old path.

preopen was unreachable; fs_at resolves an absolute path by the LONGEST

stripped, and every fs syscall (exists/read/write/open/mkdir/unlink/
rename) reads it. fd_prestat_dir_name joins the WASI effect + the import
tables; the IDE shims stub it with the same honesty as fd_prestat_get.

threading): the imports ARE the manifest — there is no config file, ever
— so a user program's one `import prelude` pulls the whole runtime

statements as inert.

default - the cold open's 16-cell grid is a feature - but the steps

bits/3ae2d41:
A bit can be wide. The shape lives in the recipe, sets the stage's aspect
and the film's dimensions, and an absent one means the tall stage every
bit has had so far, so nothing already made changes shape. The
turn-your-phone card is about a tall stage in a short window, so a wide
bit no longer shows it — that window is what a wide bit is for.

Keys, for anyone on a laptop or with a keyboard paired to a phone. Space
plays and stops, the arrows scrub, Escape backs out of whatever is open,
in that order: a sheet, then a tool, then playback, then the selection.
Nothing here is the only way to do anything, and nothing is taken from a
field, a slider or a menu.

Stickers are ready-made puppets made of the same doodle strokes a finger
would draw, so one boils, snips and takes a mouth exactly like something
you drew. There is no special case in the engine for them. Tapping again
gives a different one rather than opening a picker nobody needs.

Three coach marks, said once each, ever, through the banner rather than a
tour: where a puppet's tools are, what a pass is, and where the film is
made. A tour you cannot leave is worse than a control you have not found
yet, and localStorage being unavailable means saying them every time
rather than never.

The install prompt is held rather than dropped — Chromium fires it once,
early — and offered on the list, where it reads as a choice rather than
an ambush.

Plus a wordmark that is a heading, a stage canvas with a name that says
what is on it, and the rotate card as a live region.

Five new assertions. 73/73 checks, 101 unit tests.
